On this week's episode of the Modern Retail Podcast, Boll & Branch Chief Creative Officer Kristen Deyco spoke about how the brand's playbook and frameworks around the use of AI.

channel_news.title: Kroger’s ad business sees most profit growth since 2021
channel_news.summary: Retail media is becoming increasingly critical to one of the nation's largest grocery chains as Kroger reported its best retail media profit growth since 2021.

channel_news.title: Walgreens says it’s focused on ‘higher-performing’ ad placements as it tries again with digital screens
channel_news.summary: Walgreens wants to make digital in-store ad placements a bigger part of its retail media business. The chain plans to add digital screens with advertising and educational content in 1,200 of its stores beginning in October, a partnership with in-store media firm Looma.

channel_news.title: Why seasonal success depends on early media allocation
channel_news.summary: Seasonal demand may be predictable, but consumer behavior isn’t. By investing sooner and responding to evolving consumer signals, marketers can influence consideration, build momentum and capture demand before competition intensifies. Sponsored by Keen Decision Systems.

channel_news.title: Big-Box Briefing: Dick’s leans on youth sports in pitch to advertisers
channel_news.summary: The leader of Dick’s Sporting Goods’ advertising division hopes to recruit CPG brands, quick-service restaurants and even automakers to run campaigns in its stores and other channels. His pitch to brands and agencies last week centered around the retailer’s presence in youth sports.

channel_news.title: As online eyewear matures, GlassesUSA’s parent company doubles down on vertical integration
channel_news.summary: Online eyewear has reached a new phase of maturity, as consumers grow more confident purchasing prescription products digitally and as retailers invest in faster fulfillment, improved fit technology and more seamless omnichannel journeys. Sponsored by Optimax Eyewear Group.

channel_news.title: Instacart launches custom AI assistants for retailers, and its own
channel_news.summary: Retail giants like Walmart, Kroger and Amazon have launched AI assistants allowing consumers to ask for recommendations or curated shopping lists. Now, Instacart has made it easier for other retailers such as regional grocers to follow in their footsteps.
